name: WesBanco Inc. Depositary Shares each representing 1/40th interest in a share of 7.375% Fixed-Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock Series B
summary: WesBanco, Inc. serves as the parent entity for WesBanco Bank, Inc., providing a comprehensive array of financial products and services to both individual and business clients across the United States. Its operations are structured into two main divisions: Community Banking, and Trust and Investment Services. The company facilitates various deposit accounts, including interest-bearing and non-interest-bearing checking, money market, savings, and certificates of deposit. It also extends a diverse range of lending options, such as commercial, industrial, and residential real estate mortgages, consumer loans, land and construction financing, home equity lines of credit, and overdraft protection. Beyond traditional banking, WesBanco offers brokerage services, mortgage banking, and an extensive suite of insurance products covering property, casualty, life, and title. Additionally, the company provides mutual funds and annuities, holds commercial real estate, manages investment securities, issues letters of credit, handles international wire services, and acts as an investment advisor for a family of mutual funds. Established in 1870 and headquartered in Wheeling, West Virginia, WesBanco reaches its customers through an extensive network of branches and ATM machines located in West Virginia, Ohio, western Pennsylvania, Kentucky, southern Indiana, Michigan, and Maryland.
